pr create --repo shouteck/box-bounty-sandbox --base box-bounty/bt-930fd7566866 --head solve/bt-930fd7566866-names --title count.js: add --names flag printing only fruit names --body Solves #30.

Adds a `--names` flag to `src/count.js`: when present, only the fruit names are printed, one per line, with no count line. With no flag and with `--list`, output is unchanged.

Verified from the repository root:
- `node src/count.js` -> `data/fruit.txt lists 8 fruit`
- `node src/count.js --list` -> count line then 8 names
- `node src/count.js --names` -> 8 names, no count line
- `node --test` -> 1 pass, 0 fail

The count is unchanged, so `docs/inventory.md` still agrees. Nothing under `shared/` was touched.
